cohort: 200 pregnant women with oligohydramnios at Duhok Maternity Teaching Hospital between May 2022 and May 2023
finding: This study found a high prevalence of oligohydramnios among older, multiparous women with a history of preterm pregnancies and cesarean sections, and it was associated with adverse perinatal outcomes including fetal hypoxia, neonatal death, low birth weight, and increased cesarean section and NICU admission rates.
mod_finding: The study found that a history of previous cesarean sections was more prevalent in women with oligohydramnios.
birth_weight: Low birth weight was reported in 56 (28.0%) newborn babies
